title: Security lock screen
creator: jclthei
content:
Currently, I use BlueMail as my personal email client. I remembered Thunderbird being easy to configure and more accurate when syncing between email providers and clients.

I want to add security to my email app so when my kids play on my phone, they don't go through my emails. BlueMail allows you to use your phone's lock security, e.g. face, fingerprint, or passcode.

Is there a way to set Thunderbird to use this feature?
